'''Morvak''' is a Rhovlandian region associated with [[Geslariena]] speech, river communities, and agricultural cultural memory.

The extracted Geslariena source names Morvak alongside [[Valdris]] as one of the language's primary regions. It does not yet provide enough evidence to settle Morvak's administrative status or exact map location.

== Draft Scope ==

For the 1994-back pass, Morvak functions as a bridge page for Rhovland's internal cultural geography. Later atlas work should decide whether Morvak is a province, valley, historical district, or broader linguistic region.
